# Members of generated EMF code that are written by hand and tagged "@generated NOT".
# One per line: <plugin>/src/<path of the file> <method name>. Anything else that differs from
# what the generator writes is reported by emf_generated.py --check.
# EMF cannot carry an isSet body in the model (only the getter body, as a GenModel annotation on
# the feature in ros.ecore), so this one stays by hand.
